name: python-sdk
//: The Python SDK, on the oldest supported interpreter (python/.python-version). Its targets run from the repository root, as its suites expect. `build` stages the release-stamped package (scripts/python-sdk-pack.mjs) and builds its wheel and sdist into python/dist/sdk-dist, as the release's build-python-sdk job does. `test` enforces 95% branch-inclusive coverage over oneharness_sdk; `e2e` builds and installs the release-stamped wheels and is not part of `test`. `test` and `e2e` each run alone (`parallelism: false`), since scripts/check-temp-leaks.sh can tell another live run's scratch from this one's only by reading its maker's environment, which Windows does not expose: run beside each other there, each read the other's live scratch as its own leak.

commands: uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff format --check python/oneharness-sdk
uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff format python/oneharness-sdk
uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff check python/oneharness-sdk
uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ty check --project python/oneharness-sdk
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; package="$(node scripts/python-sdk-pack.mjs)"; uv build --quiet --out-dir python/dist/sdk-dist "$package"'

bash scripts/check-temp-leaks.sh uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync coverage run --rcfile=python/oneharness-sdk/pyproject.toml -m unittest discover -s python/oneharness-sdk/test -p test_*.py -t python/oneharness-sdk
bash scripts/check-temp-leaks.sh uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync python python/oneharness-sdk/test/package_e2e.py
